strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: The Rust runtime lets an explicit headless continuation apply one approved recovery-scoped proposal and advance to the verification retry boundary.
The apply step delegates to the existing controlled proposal.apply path so mutation policy, authorization, preflight, and post-write verification remain runtime-owned.
The continuation records bounded decision evidence and replays the apply result without duplicating workspace mutation or leaking raw file content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting controlled_workspace_tools, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can apply one already-approved recovery-scoped replace_file proposal under explicit authorization and route to start_verification_retry_explicitly.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: proposal.apply can mutate files, but it is not bound to headless progress freshness, recovery provenance, continuation replay, and the recovery-loop route contract.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless recovery remains stuck at proposal review and external callers must manually switch to proposal.apply outside the autonomous continuation contract.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M18.1 admitted recovery tasks, M18.2 ran a targeted recovery task to proposal review, and M18.3 applies the approved proposal to the retry-start boundary.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.continue_once method is extended.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The result reuses the existing bounded ProposalApplyResult and HeadlessContinueRoute structures.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: A valid current headless continuation performs an actual controlled workspace mutation through the existing proposal.apply path and records bounded continuation evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Moves Brownie from approved recovery proposal to explicit verifier retry startup without caller-owned RPC switching and without automatic verifier execution.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the next M18 recovery-loop control boundary between repair proposal review and verification retry admission.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts bounded verification_recovery_apply_target evidence with explicit recovery-apply authorization
current aggregate progress fingerprint and sequence are checked before any proposal.apply mutation
valid recovery apply target evidence invokes the existing controlled proposal.apply implementation and records WorkspacePatchApplyResultRecorded
the result includes bounded proposal_apply_result metadata and routes to start_verification_retry_explicitly without starting or running verifier retry automatically
replaying the same continuation_id returns the same apply result and route without a duplicate WorkspacePatchApplyResultRecorded or duplicate mutation
stale progress, missing recovery-apply authorization, stale source fingerprint, malformed target, mismatched provenance, or non-recovery-scoped proposal fails before mutation

no new RPC, diagnostics wrapper, readiness report, scheduler, automatic verifier retry execution, provider/shell/git/network/service expansion, VSIX policy ownership, or raw data exposure is introduced
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M18.3 merge, assess M18 milestone exit. If another distinct boundary remains, consider admitting or running verification retry under the same explicit headless continuation contract without scheduler or automatic execution.
